Author: Panda
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description: Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
No database change. Works with any app version.

- FCTracker, read in one go. With the newest FCTracker, the plugin asks for every character's and Free Company's details in two calls, instead of one call per character and Free Company. Older FCTrackers are asked one at a time as before, and the oldest are still read from their file.
- /xivfleet check shows FCTracker's IPC version when it says, for example "details read directly from it (IPC version 1)".
